links.outcome: Agreement of XAI attribution maps with expert reasoning for parotid segmentation
links.effect: GBP and PNet-A qualitatively agreed most with expert reasoning; other XAI methods agreed less. Curated models produced cleaner GCAM attributions.
links.quote: GBP and PNet-A qualitatively agreed most with expert reasoning on directly (structure borders) and indirectly (proxies used for identifying structure borders) important features for PG segmentation.

links.outcome: Ability of XAI topological signal to flag insufficient segmentation contours a priori
links.effect: Guided GCAM EC-profile PC lambda1 sensitivity>0.85, specificity>0.90; AUROC 0.66, 0.74, 0.94, 0.83 for GBP, GCAM, GGCAM, PNet-A; 87% of cases below threshold were insufficient.
links.quote: Quantitative analysis showed that PCλ<sub>1</sub> of guided GCAM's (GGCAM) Euler characteristic (EC) profile had good predictive value (sensitivity>0.85, specificity>0.90) of DSC for AAPM cases, with AUROC = 0.66, 0.74, 0.94, 0.83 for GBP, GCAM, GGCAM and PNet-A.

unlisted_practices: Using explainable AI attribution maps and topological data analysis to flag potentially inadequate auto-contours before clinical review

screen.reason: The study develops and tests a safeguard method (using topological data analysis of explainability maps to a-priori flag inadequate or failing auto-contours) to improve the safety of clinical deployment of segmentation CNNs.

primary.practice: automated quality assurance / failure detection of segmentation using XAI topological features
